title: PT Launch Lab LIVE - Wednesday 29 July, 8pm
summary: Where is the fitness industry really heading in 2026? Join us live this Wednesday at 8pm for a no-filter panel on AI, GLP-1s, fitness tech, the future of PT, and commercial gyms vs independents. On the panel: Jon Baker (Operations Director, The Gym Group), Chris Duffin, Sohail Rashid of Brawn, Paul Richardson, Tom Blackman of Ministry of Fitness and Jonny Grayshon of Vaxa. Free to attend, roughly an hour, with live Q&A - bring your questions. Register and we will send the watch link.
